snippet.title: Virtua Fighter 5 R.E.V.O. World Stage | Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Virtua Fighter 5 R.E.V.O. World Stage is AVAILABLE NOW on PlayStation 5, XBOX Series X|S and Steam!

PlayStation®5: Virtua Fighter 5 R.E.V.O. World Stage Standard Edition
Xbox Series X|S: Buy Virtua Fighter 5 R.E.V.O. World Stage | Xbox
Steam: Virtua Fighter 5 R.E.V.O. World Stage on Steam

7 tournaments. Countless Rivals. One Champion. Dominate the World Stage where Legends are made in an all-new single player mode, or challenge opponents online across the globe and across platforms seamlessly with Crossplay and Rollback netcode.

Features:
All-new Single Player Mode: World Stage
Crossplay + Rollback Netcode support across all platforms
Improved Training tools and Replay Features
New DLC Fighter: DURAL joins the fight!
 
ALSO! If you’ve ever owned Virtua Fighter 5 Ultimate Showdown on PlayStation 4 through PlayStation Plus or digital purchase, you’re entitled to a special ownership discount on Virtua Fighter 5 R.E.V.O. World Stage!* Steam owners of Virtua Fighter 5 R.E.V.O. will automatically receive a FREE update to World Stage.

Official X (Twitter) https://x.com/vf_official
Official Website https://virtua-fighter.com/revo/jp/
Official Discord Community Server   / discord   Join the community for the latest updates and player interaction!

* Players that own the PS4 version of VF5 Ultimate Showdown shall receive a $9.99 discount off Virtua Fighter 5 R.E.V.O. World Stage for PlayStation 5, base or 30th Anniversary Edition. Redemption available through PSN account only.

#VirtuaFighter #VF5REVO #Steam #LegacyVF #SEGA
